programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Giant Cat 5090B Front Shovel Excavator Loading Gravel On Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, capturing the raw power and precision of the Caterpillar 5090B Front Shovel Excavator. This giant machine is seen loading gravel from a deposit area onto a fleet of 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks, preparing materials for ongoing operations across the mine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Bigmouth steals the Smurfs' winter food supply and Brainy concocts one of Papa Smurf's magic strength potions so he can fight the greedy giant. The super formula wears off, but Papa Smurf works a fast switch, replacing the food with rocks and Bigmouth is none the wiser.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha turns herself into a Smurf, plotting revenge on the little people for destroying her magic locket. Papa Smurf outwits her and banishes her from the forest once more.

programme.title: The Baby Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel turns himself into a Baby Smurf, to be adopted by the Smurfette. He causes complete chaos in the Smurf Village when he tries to blow it up with a time bomb! Papa Smurf discovers his evil plot and uses the explosive to send the wizard back to his dismal castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' winter food supply is destroyed and they journey to a distant castle in search of shelter. programme.title: The Purple Smurfs
programme.desc: The purple fly bites Lazy and an epidemic starts that turns the little villagers into angry, purple Smurfs. Papa Smurf discovers that the pollen from a tuberose flower is an antidote and soon things are smurfy again.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy makes an enlarging potion that turns Hefty into human size. The big-little strong man captures Gargamel and brings him back to the Smurf Village where Papa Smurf magically causes Azrael to chase his master back to his dreary castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The underground trolls who want them to be their slaves capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf ingeniously frees them and then destroys the trolls' magic crystal ball that gives them power over the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In an effort to find out where the Smurfs' secret diamond stash is hidden, Gargamel pretends to be their friend. When he shows his true, wicked self, Papa Smurf works a magic spell to save his little Smurfs from the vicious clutches of the evil wizard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Lazy dreams he is on Paradise Island and free from all the work Papa Smurf inflicts on him. His fantasy turns into a nightmare that sends him eagerly back to work once more.

programme.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
programme.desc: Brainy and his friends organize a journey to Ice Mountain to pick the rare snow flower for Papa Smurf. They meet a terrifying snow beast that befriends them, due to Smurfette's kindness, and helps them find the tiny flower.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette has found a new friend, Laura, a six-year-old child whose parents live near the forest. Together, the two girls wander in the forest. But an old witch who lives in the forest catches them.

programme.title: Gormandizing Greedy
programme.desc: Greedy overdoes it. He's getting heavier and heavier until his weight puts him in jeopardy. The evil Gargamel is going to catch him... Can Greedy be saved by Papa Smurf?

programme.title: Head Over Hogatha
programme.desc: Valentine's Day. Hogatha, the witch, is at the pond picking spore rot when, by accident, one of Cupid's arrows hits her. Now she is going to fall madly in love with the first man she sees... And as luck would have it, that man is Gargamel himself. Will he succeed in having her catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop and will Hogatha get out of her fell swoop?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf's had enough. The Smurflings and Sassette keep on telling tales about him with unpleasant results. He therefore concocts a magic formula, taken from Papa Smurf's books of spells, which makes the little Smurfs' tails grow longer and longer every time they tell tales. What he hasn't counted on is that Gargamel now has a way of catching the Smurflings.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the emergency call rings, all the Smurfs in the Village drop what they are doing and run to hear the news. But when Vanity Smurf calls for an assembly so that the Smurfs can admire his new hat, it is too much. They send him on his way out of the village, and Vanity has the bad luck of meeting Lofty, the Elf, who suggests a horrible mud bath...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? Truth will out when Smurfette and the Smurflings meet the frog. They help to change this frog back into Prince Theodore himself, for he's been the victim of a spell cast by Morlock.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every 500 years, Castle Captor appears and abducts innocent travelers. Grandpa takes off in his balloon for the castle, where he meets Nanny Smurf, who’s been missing for 500 years. They have only a short time to escape, or they’ll become permanent guests!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty, Handy, and Brainy lose Papa's telescope and Scour, the Lord of Lost and Found, finds it. The Smurfs say they'll trade anything to get it back, so Scour takes their most valuable possessions – handiness, heftiness and braininess. They journey to his domain to retrieve what was lost.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil warlock Nemesis shows up at the Wizards' Library to steal the knowledge from the Archives of Evil and so get the Long Life Stone. But it's Brainy who inadvertently saves the day when he switches Greedy's cookbook and Papa's spell book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Roommates Smurfette and Nanny are getting on each other's nerves, so the time has come for Nanny to have a house of her own. As Nanny and Smurfette trek off to find a house-warming plant, the others design the Smurfliest house for her.

programme.title: Smurfing For Ghosts
programme.desc: Peewit is at the castle of his friends Selwyn and Tallulah when Uncle Fenwick, the friendly ghost, asks for his help in chasing a few relatives who've come to haunt him... Peewit has to get help from the Smurfs, and a merry chase begins...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: We all know Grouchy Smurf hates a lot of things. But one thing he hates more than anything else is water, when there is enough of it to drown in. You see, Grouchy can't swim. And when the Smurfs notice this peculiarity and try to teach him how to survive in water, the evil wizard Gargamel makes things a little more dangerous than they ought to be....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. As if matters weren't difficult enough, here's Gargamel...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs are three apples high. Smurflings are twenty-five smurfberries high. Except for Slouchy, who only measures twenty-two smurfberries. Apart from Baby Smurf, Slouchy is the shortest Smurf, and the jibes and taunts of the other Smurflings make him wish he were the tallest of the Smurfs... Now it so happens that Gourdy the Genie loves to grant wishes...

programme.title: Smurfette's Gift
programme.desc: Every year, Smurfette snoops around to discover what her birthday presents will be before she receives them. But this year, Sassette has created the Keep-Smurfette's-Presents-a-Surprise-Committee. Nat has discovered a cave where they might be able to hide all the gifts prepared by the Smurfs. But what this cave also hides is a greedy imp who is not only interested in keeping Smurfette's gifts...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh dear! Sassette has lost a tooth. Papa Smurf explains that if she puts her tooth under her pillow, the Mouse Fairy will bring her a present in the morning. But the next morning there is no present under the pillow. The Mouse Fairy has not been. She has been captured in one of Gargamel’s Smurf traps. And now the evil wizard is concocting a dreadful plan.

programme.title: Smurfs On Wheels
programme.desc: Every year, all the Smurfs make the long hike to Dreamy Steamy Springs. But this year, only Grandpa Smurf, Papa Smurf and Nat are going to walk there. All the other Smurfs are too busy – and too lazy – to walk. But then Handy comes up with what he calls his Customised Smurfwagon. No need to walk, you just let yourself roll along... Of course, things won't be as simple as all that.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poet Smurf's new play is going to be his greatest work ever, and it will feature the most favourite Smurf of all: Smurfette in the leading female role. Brainy Smurf, self-appointed manager of the play, does not see it that way...

programme.title: Reckless Smurfs

programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds’ language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal confirma sus sospechas con respecto a Ana y a su primo, sabe que ambos le están mintiendo pero no va a decir nada porque no quiere perder a su novia antes de casarse. Escucha los consejos de Pedro de que mantenga la calma y no la cele porque lo único que va a lograr es que Ana lo deje. Ana siente que cuando más conoce a Guillermo más se da cuenta que es el hombre de su vida. Mientras tanto Nancy explota cuando llegan a su apartamento Lázara y Pedro con la intención de hablar con Carlos de las cuentas del condominio, todo armado por el Fantasma que crea cizaña con todos. Nancy se va del apartamento enojada a buscar a un vecino que si admira su belleza y la piropea.

programme.title: Episodio 111
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se besan como les exigen en la película pero ellos se besan de verdad y cuando dicen corten | ellos siguen besándose. Intervienen entonces Briggite y Juan Diego. Lolita trata de convencer a Solymar que lo que es del cura va para la iglesia. Freddy se burla de Yubiri por lo del beso. Briggite llega y también le dice que terminó siendo una gran actriz Carolina y Juan Diego tienen una gran discusión. Ella le reclama que haya dicho corte por el megáfono.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía continúa haciendo todo lo posible por lograr que Agustín y Magdalena se divorcien, ya que lo quiere solamente para ella. Esta vez, lo emborracha y lo convence de pasar la noche juntos. Agustín no vuelve a su casa hasta el otro día, cuando pone la excusa de que ha tenido que dormir solo en un hotel. Gabriel empieza a darse cuenta de la gravedad de su enfermedad y se emociona hablando con Gloria de los viejos tiempos en que los dos junto con Epicúreo eran inseparables. Está dispuesto a hacer todo con tal de no morirse a causa de su problema en los riñones. Maikel está cansado de la mentira de su tío a Valentina, está cansado de que lo vean como una persona que no es. Es por eso que, aparentemente, puede llegar a decir toda la verdad que Epicúreo tiene tan bien guardada.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia y Ricardo promete casarse con ella al día siguiente. Mientras tanto, Manuela intenta mediar en el conflicto entre Ricardo, Misael y Glorita. René y Gustavo son arrestados tras un altercado, y Katiuska muestra su desprecio hacia la servidumbre. A pesar de su fiebre alta, Celia se niega a ir al médico y prefiere pasear con su familia para que todos los vean unidos antes de partir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos logra que Junior reaccione tras el desmayo. Adolfo y Consuelo revelan a Rosa que su matrimonio debe anularse porque Junior es su hermano; ella confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro. Blanca enfrenta a Arminda por haberle ocultado el paradero de Rosa toda la vida. Junior reclama a Marisela haberle ocultado la gravedad de su enfermedad. Erasto irrumpe en su casa al ver a Blanca y la amenaza, pero ella le anuncia que peleará por sus tierras. Rosa jura que siempre considerará a Carmen Rosa como su única madre y nunca dejará a Junior solo.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Milagros y Enzo están en el ascensor y mientras ella cuenta para que él lo haga andar él le quita los documentos de la cartera para que ella tenga que volver a verlo. Vicky está enojada porque vio a Enzo besándose con Milagros. Él trata de compensarla llevándola al club, pero cuando ella se va a la habitación él se escapa para la empresa para volver a ver a Milagros, quien va a buscar sus documentos. Augusto revisa a María Gracia y no encuentra ninguna herida, por lo que le dice que está bien.

Maikel está cansado de la mentira de su tío a Valentina, está cansado de que lo vean como una persona que no es. Es por eso que, aparentemente, puede llegar a decir toda la verdad que Epicúreo tiene tan bien guardada.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia y Ricardo promete casarse con ella al día siguiente. Mientras tanto, Manuela intenta mediar en el conflicto entre Ricardo, Misael y Glorita. René y Gustavo son arrestados tras un altercado, y Katiuska muestra su desprecio hacia la servidumbre. A pesar de su fiebre alta, Celia se niega a ir al médico y prefiere pasear con su familia para que todos los vean unidos antes de partir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos logra que Junior reaccione tras el desmayo. Adolfo y Consuelo revelan a Rosa que su matrimonio debe anularse porque Junior es su hermano; ella confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro. Blanca enfrenta a Arminda por haberle ocultado el paradero de Rosa toda la vida. Junior reclama a Marisela haberle ocultado la gravedad de su enfermedad. Erasto irrumpe en su casa al ver a Blanca y la amenaza, pero ella le anuncia que peleará por sus tierras. Rosa jura que siempre considerará a Carmen Rosa como su única madre y nunca dejará a Junior solo.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia le dice a la madre Pilar que quiere ver a Milagros al día siguiente en su oficina, ya que piensa que Milagros le dio a Enzo el golpe que se merecía; pero no sólo eso, sino que siente que le debe a Milagros que salvara a su hija Gina de un secuestro. Clemencia reunida con su familia les dice que tomó tres decisiones, quiere que Gina se vaya a estudiar a Boston, que Enzo formalice su relación con Vicky y que pongan fecha de matrimonio.
